newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kinkel arrives in Moscow for talks on NATO.
newsitem.headline: Kinkel arrives in Moscow for talks on NATO.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel arrived in Moscow on Tuesday for talks which will centre on NATO's plan to expand eastwards and Moscow's fierce opposition to the Western allaince's enlargement.
Kinkel is the latest Western leader to visit Moscow in efforts to soften Russia's opposition to the plan to offer membership to some countries in eastern and central Europe.
The Kremlin says such expansion would threaten Moscow's security and weaken President Boris Yeltsin's authority in Russia.

During the two-day visit Kinkel is expected to meet Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov and Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin. He will also discuss some bilateral issues and other security matters.
Before coming to Moscow, Kinkel met new U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright in Bonn this week.

Albright is on a tour of European capitals and is trying to ensure a united front within NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organisation) on its planned expansion before she holds talks with Yeltsin in Moscow on Friday.
